governed_construct: One instance per dependency-acquisition site in the file: (a) each class decorated with `@injectable()` (receives dependencies by constructor injection; conforming), and (b) each call that resolves a dependency through the `getIt` service locator, i.e. a call to, or a method call on, a binding imported/required as the export `getIt` from the project's DI container module (whatever local alias it is bound to); calls to unrelated local functions or variables that merely happen to be named `getIt` are not instances.
interpretation: The rule asks that dependencies be supplied through decorator-driven constructor injection (`@injectable()` from tsyringe/inversify) rather than pulled from the `getIt` service locator. A file is VIOLATED if it contains any call that goes through the service-locator binding (`getIt<T>()`, `getIt.get<T>(...)`, or the same through an aliased import such as `import { getIt as locator }`), even if the file also has `@injectable` classes. It is SATISFIED if it has at least one `@injectable` class and no service-locator call. Mentions of `getIt` in comments or strings, and calls to a locally declared function named `getIt` that is not bound to the DI container, do not count. Files with neither injectable classes nor locator calls are NOT_APPLICABLE. Because the identity of `getIt` depends on its binding (import vs local declaration vs alias), the rule is T3.
